description: This is a team currently developing a game where the player manages a space colony on the moon or mars and faces challenges like food, power and water shortages. The player must navigate these obstacles to create a successful colony. The game is developed in godot with the use of AI.
summary:
My project is an educational space-colony management game designed to teach and inspire students by introducing them to the challenges of operating a lunar or Martian base.

The game uses real maps of the Moon and Mars, allowing players to explore their terrain and understand how location affects colony construction and operations. It also features real spacecraft developed for NASA's Human Landing System programme, including Blue Origin's Blue Moon Mk1 and Mk2 landers and SpaceX's Starship crew and cargo vehicles with estimated mission costs. Players must also manage essential resources such as food and water, with consumption requirements based on data from the International Space Station. 

By combining real-world space technology, geography and resource management, my game makes the complex challenges of establishing an extraterrestrial colony more accessible and engaging for students.
details:
My project is an educational colony-management game developed in Godot, where players establish and manage a settlement on the Moon or Mars. Players must balance essential resources such as food, water, material and power to keep their astronauts alive and ensuring the colony can operate successfully.

To make the experience realistic and educational, I incorporated real geographical maps of the Moon and Mars, allowing players to explore different terrain types and understand how the choice of location affects a settlement. I also included real spacecraft concepts from NASA's Human Landing System programme, such as Blue Origin's Blue Moon Mk1 and Mk2 landers and SpaceX's Starship crew and cargo vehicles, alongside estimated costs. Resource consumption is based on data from the International Space Station.

I developed the game using the Godot Engine, with AI assistance. My main goal was to make the engineering and logistical challenges of space exploration accessible and engaging, particularly for younger learners.

The creative aspect of my project is combining real-world space technology, planetary geography and resource management into an interactive simulation. I considered realism, resource limitations, mission costs and the differences between operating on the Moon and Mars. I hope the game will inspire students to take an interest in space exploration, engineering and STEM.
